rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Scope of Fact-finding Survey) The scope of the fact-finding survey on the tea industry pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the “Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)is as follows:
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Scope of Fact-Finding Survey) The scope of the fact-finding survey on the tea industry pursuant to Article 6(1) of the Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) is as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. Cultivated varieties and planting status of tea trees
rows.text_en: 1. Cultivated varieties and planting status of tea trees

rows.source_ko: 2. Production Status of Tea Leaves by Harvesting Season
rows.text_en: 2. Production Status of Tea Leaves by Harvesting Season

rows.source_ko: 3. Current Status of Tea Processing, Manufacturing, Distribution, and Sales
rows.text_en: 3. Current Status of Tea Processing, Manufacturing, Distribution, and Sales

rows.source_ko: 4. Consumer satisfaction and awareness of the car
rows.text_en: 4. Consumer satisfaction and awareness of tea

rows.source_ko: 5. Current Status of Tea Exports and Imports
rows.text_en: 5. Current Status of Tea Exports and Imports

rows.source_ko: 6. Current status of workers in the second industry, including gender
rows.text_en: 6. Current status of workers in the second industry, including gender

rows.source_ko: 7. Matters concerning domestic and international trends and prospects of the tea industry
rows.text_en: 7. Matters concerning domestic and international trends and prospects of the tea industry

rows.source_ko: 8. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the development of the tea industry
rows.text_en: 8. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs for the development of the tea industry

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Designation of Educational and Training Institutions, etc.) ①Any institution or organization seeking designation as an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service , in accordance with Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), an application for designation as an educational and training institution in the form of Annex No. 1 , with the following documents attached.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Designation of Educational and Training Institutions, etc.) ①Any institution or organization seeking designation as an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service , in accordance with Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Development of the Tea Industry and Promotion of Tea Culture (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), an application for designation as an educational and training institution in the form of Annex No. 1 , with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. Current Status of Educational Facilities and Equipment
rows.text_en: 1. Current Status of Educational Facilities and Equipment

rows.source_ko: 2. Operation plan including curriculum and educational content
rows.text_en: 2. Operation plan including curriculum and educational content

rows.source_ko: 3. Status of securing relevant personnel, such as instructors
rows.text_en: 3. Status of securing relevant personnel, such as instructors

rows.source_ko: 4. Operating Expense Financing Plan
rows.text_en: 4. Operating Expense Financing Plan

rows.source_ko: 5. Record of performing car-related education and training (only applicable if there is a record)
rows.text_en: 5. Record of performing tea-related education and training (only applicable if there is a record)

rows.source_ko: ② The certificate of designation of an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of designation of an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree is as in Form No. 2 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ When the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service issues a certificate of designation for an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall post the following matters on the websites of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service.
rows.text_en: ③ When the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service issues a certificate of designation for an educational and training institution pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall post the following matters on the websites of the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service.

rows.source_ko: 1. Designation Number and Designation Date
rows.text_en: 1. Designation Number and Designation Date

rows.source_ko: 2. Name of the educational and training institution
rows.text_en: 2. Name of the educational and training institution

rows.text_en: 4. Location of the educational and training institution

rows.source_ko: 5. Education and Training Field
rows.text_en: 5. Education and Training Field

rows.source_ko: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters necessary for the designation and operation of educational and training institutions shall be determined and announced by the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service .
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed matters necessary for the designation and operation of educational and training institutions shall be determined and announced by the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service .

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions, etc.) ①Any person who intends to be designated as a professional training institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, in accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, an application for designation as a professional training institution in Form No. 3 of the Appendix, with the following documents attached.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions, etc.) ①Any person who intends to be designated as a professional training institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Director of the National Agricultural Products Quality Management Service, in accordance with Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, an application for designation as a professional training institution in Form No. 3 of the Appendix, with the following documents attached.

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Standards for Labeling Quality, etc. of Tea) The standards for labeling quality, etc. of tea pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: Article 5-2 (Holding and Operation of Evaluation Meetings, etc.) ① The tea evaluation meeting pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “evaluation meeting”) shall be held annually. However, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may change the frequency of the meeting if deemed necessary for the efficient holding and operation of the evaluation meeting.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Holding and Operation of Evaluation Meetings, etc.) ① The tea evaluation meeting pursuant to Article 14-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “evaluation meeting”) shall be held annually. However, the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may change the frequency of the meeting if deemed necessary for the efficient holding and operation of the evaluation meeting.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may publicize the results of evaluations, etc., if deemed necessary for the development of the tea industry and the promotion of tea culture.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may publicize the results of evaluations, etc., if deemed necessary for the development of the tea industry and the promotion of tea culture.

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may, at the request of the winner, allow products that have won awards at the evaluation meeting under Paragraph 1 to have the award results attached or printed on packaging, containers, shipping documents, transaction statements, etc., for a certain period.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs may, at the request of the winner, allow products that have won awards at the evaluation meeting under Paragraph 1 to have the award results attached or printed on packaging, containers, shipping documents, transaction statements, etc., for a certain period.

rows.source_ko: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the holding and operation of evaluation meetings, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the holding and operation of evaluation meetings, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs .
